Student packets, one class at a time

Choose a module, then download the pages for today's class. Each packet starts with Name, Date and Period. Build directions, word help, diagrams and test notes are included.

Printer settings: US Letter · Actual size / 100% · Two-sided · Flip on long edge.
Color is helpful; every diagram also has labels for black-and-white printing. Use real colored paper for sensor activities, not a grayscale printout.
